$comment: The phone-number rule, as data, so both implementations can be driven from ONE file.
The rule lives twice — `api/ClinicManagement.Domain/ValueObjects/PhoneNumber.cs` for the server and
`web/lib/phone.ts` for the browser's pre-check — and until this file existed the only thing holding the two
together was a comment in each saying the other was a mirror. That is the state
`OdontogramConditionMirrorTests` calls « a mirror nobody checks is a mirror that is already wrong ».
Why a corpus rather than a set-equality guard like this repo's others: both sides are PURE TOTAL FUNCTIONS
OF A STRING, which no other mirrored rule here is. So the two can be driven from the same inputs and pinned
to the same outputs, which is stronger than comparing two declarations and is available nowhere else.
Both fail on a parsed count of zero, so « found nothing » cannot read as « nothing was wrong ».
`region` is the country assumed when the number carries no country code; absent means defaultRegion.
`expected` null means the number must be refused.
